source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew verse numbering align throughout Exodus 12–18.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves their idealized recollection as direct speech, divine hand and accusation of fatal starvation.
Supplies the prior knowledge clause to complete elliptical when-giving syntax; retains repeated question and explicit source contrast.
Retains repeated fine and frost simile while choosing flaky for uncertain texture term without identifying a natural substance.
Keeps question and explanatory ignorance repetition; man hu link to manna supplied in vocabulary.
Keeps outcome without inserting redistribution or a miraculous resizing mechanism absent in verse.
Marks plural rebuke within singular address to Moses; no claim that only Moses disobeyed.
Preserves Sabbath as gift, rationale and full spatial prohibition without importing later travel-distance rules.
Keeps house collective, food name, color, seed comparison and taste without asserting manna equals coriander.
Retains testimony rather than importing ark into main text; note acknowledges anticipatory narrative reference.
